{{Quote|As possible rival bounty hunters go, these might not be too bad. Assuming they haven't finished their new war droid. But... it'd probably be a good idea to get them before they finish. [...] The warehouse they shipped the parts to is in a really sketchy part of town. It'll be tough to get to.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TU" />}}
The '''Ugnaught Clan Warehouse''' was a warehouse located in the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:TU" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> three [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Gornik]], [[Slatblath]], and [[Ugmir]], participants of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] attempted to repair their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in the warehouse.<ref name="TOR:TU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ugnaught Clan Warehouse appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:TU" />
